message.content:
Below is a quick‑look list of the **federal public holidays** that create “long weekends” (i.e., a holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, or is observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend) in Canada for the calendar year 2023.  
(If you’re interested in province‑specific holidays—e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, Family Day in Ontario, etc.—just let me know and I’ll add those too.)

| Holiday | Observed Date (2023) | Long Weekend Dates (2023) | Notes |
|---------|----------------------|---------------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 2 (Monday) – observed because Jan 1 was Sunday | **Jan 1–2** (Sun–Mon) | The holiday itself is Jan 1, but the observed day gives a 2‑day weekend. |
| **Family Day** *(Ontario, BC, Alberta, etc.)* | Feb 20 (Monday) | **Feb 18–20** (Sat–Mon) | Only provinces that observe Family Day get this long weekend. |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Friday) | **Apr 7–9** (Fri–Sun) | Good Friday itself is the holiday. |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | **May 20–22** (Sat–Mon) | The holiday is the Monday. |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 3 (Monday) – observed because Jul 1 was Saturday | **Jul 1–3** (Sat–Mon) | The holiday itself is Jul 1. |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | **Sep 2–4** (Sat–Mon) | The holiday is the Monday. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | **Oct 7–9** (Sat–Mon) | The holiday is the Monday. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 13 (Monday) – observed because Nov 11 was Saturday | **Nov 11–13** (Sat–Mon) | The holiday itself is Nov 11. |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Monday) | **Dec 23–25** (Sat–Mon) | The holiday is the Monday. |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | — | No long weekend (falls on a Tuesday). |

### Quick Summary of Long Weekend Dates (2023)

- **Jan 1–2** (New Year’s Day)  
- **Feb 18–20** (Family Day – in provinces that observe it)  
- **Apr 7–9** (Good Friday)  
- **May 20–22** (Victoria Day)  
- **Jul 1–3** (Canada Day)  
- **Sep 2–4** (Labour Day)  
- **Oct 7–9** (Thanksgiving)  
- **Nov 11–13** (Remembrance Day)  
- **Dec 23–25** (Christmas Day)

Feel free to let me know if you’d like province‑specific holidays added or if you need the dates formatted differently for your app!
